definition.title: The Foundry Road
definition.briefing: Rakka leads a forge crew through the abandoned quarry. Stay beside foreman Torg, clear the two ambushes, and bring him to the eastern workshop.
definition.successText: Torg reaches the workshop and restores its furnaces. Rakka can shelter the valley refugees behind the new iron gates.
definition.failureText: The forge crew is lost in the quarry. Rakka must return to the road with the same escort.

objectives.text: Escort convoy through all 3 checkpoints. Keep troops within seven tiles so the convoy advances.
Keep Rakka Ironjaw alive until the convoy arrives.

definition.title: Refuge at Iron Gate
definition.briefing: Mara has followed the refugee column. Hold the Iron Hall for seventy seconds while Torg closes the shelter doors. Spend the repair timber carefully; only two replacement soldiers may join.
definition.successText: The refugees survive. Rakka must choose whether to recover the toll bridge or search the enemy courier camp for a safer crossing.
definition.failureText: The shelter falls before its doors close. The refugees need the Iron Hall intact.

objectives.text: Hold the fortress for 70 seconds. The reinforcement allowance is 2; the listed waves are finite.
Keep Rakka Ironjaw alive during the defense.

actions.speaker: Rakka Ironjaw
actions.text: Their archers are behind the second rank. Push them away from the tower.

actions.speaker: Rakka Ironjaw
actions.text: This is the last wave. Torg needs twenty more seconds.

definition.title: Break the Toll Line
definition.briefing: The toll keeper has pikes across the bridge and prism archers behind them. Your riders must use the southern ford while the Ironjaws pin the pikes. Destroy both marked archers with this army.
definition.successText: The toll line breaks. The refugees can cross openly, and Rakka confronts the keeper in his forge court.
definition.failureText: The riders are trapped at the pikes. Reset the engagement and send them around the wet southern route.

objectives.text: Destroy the two marked prism archers. Keep at least one rider alive.
Keep Rakka Ironjaw alive. The army and zero-resource budget are fixed; reset restores this starting position.

definition.title: The Keeper's Furnace
definition.briefing: The Brass Keeper waits among the furnace pits. Build Fury with the Ironjaws' War Cry. Rakka's Iron Command strengthens their attacks. Split the line when a heat circle appears and concentrate attacks to interrupt the keeper's charge.
definition.successText: Rakka stops the furnace and frees the valley from the toll. Torg gives the workshop to the refugees rather than another keeper.
definition.failureText: Rakka falls inside the furnace court. The keeper still controls the crossing.

objectives.text: Defeat Brass Keeper. Survive all three phases and move out of a warning circle or interrupt it with concentrated fire.
Dodge or interrupt at least one telegraphed attack.
